Subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2 / retention / audit logs / next steps (ACME)

Hi Jordan — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call + proposed next steps.

Key pain points you mentioned:
- Need auditable retention + exportable audit logs for API calls and model outputs (regulatory audits).
- SOC 2 Type II evidence and recent pen test summary required for procurement and security review.
- Data residency and KMS/HSM controls for customer-managed keys (ACME needs options).
- Clarity on data retention defaults and ability to extend to multi-year retention for legal/regulatory requests.

Goals we heard:
1) Confirm Redwood can provide SOC 2 + pen test evidence and sign DPA.
2) Verify audit log retention/export and ability to deliver logs for audits.
3) Confirm encryption + KMS options and any additional controls for production PII workloads.
4) Schedule a security deep-dive to review evidence and deployment design.

Next steps (proposed):
- I will share SOC 2 Type II report, pen test summary, and a current DPA (attached) — Marissa (today).
- Loop in our security engineer (Neha) to answer audit-log, retention, and KMS questions — Marissa (today).
- Schedule 45-min security deep-dive (Jordan + ACME security/procurement, Neha + Dylan) — propose Wed Jul 15 or Thu Jul 16.
- Procurement to share required contract redlines / PO timeline.

Please confirm these items and your availability for the deep-dive.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2 / retention / audit logs / next steps (ACME)

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and attachments below. Happy to go deeper in the security deep-dive.

1) SOC 2 / Pen test
- Attached: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf and pen_test_summary_2024.pdf. The SOC 2 report covers our control environment through 2025 and is appropriate to share under NDA/standard procurement review. The pen test summary is a vendor-commissioned high-level report (redacted) — we can provide more detail under an executed NDA if required.

2) Audit logs / retention
- Default audit log retention: 1 year (configurable).
- Exportability: Logs are exportable in JSON and CSV via our admin console and can be pushed to S3 or pulled via API for SIEM ingestion.
- Long-term retention: We offer archival policies for 1, 3, or 7+ year retention; for 3+ years we typically export to an ACME-managed S3 bucket (encrypted at rest) or to a cold archive.

3) KMS / HSM / encryption
- Support for customer-managed encryption keys (BYOK) via AWS KMS or equivalent cloud KMS.
- HSM-backed key provisioning available for Dedicated/Private deployments; hosted option uses Redwood-managed keys unless BYOK is configured.

4) DPA / legal
- Attached: Redwood_DPA_v3.docx. We accept standard redlines; please have procurement/Legal send redlines to legal@redwood.com. DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABCDEF123456

5) Evidence delivery options
- For audits we can deliver: SOC 2 report, pen test summary, and scoped system diagrams. For deeper evidence (logs, raw artifacts) we'll execute a one-way NDA and a controlled evidence access window.

Availability: Wed Jul 15 at 10:30 PT works for us. Dylan — can you send an invite for 45 minutes and include a dial-in + secure attendee list?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
